entries.scope: Undici 6.29.0 bundled inside npm 12.2.1, used only by release tooling and never shipped with the Home Assistant integration
entries.reason: Owner-approved temporary renewal through 2026-11-08 after renewed dependency and exposure review on 2026-11-01. Only GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c, GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx and GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm at this exact bundled npm path are covered. Published npm 12.2.1 and 11.21.1 still contain undici 6.29.0; npm 10.9.9 introduces additional high-severity findings and overrides do not replace the shrinkwrapped bundle. The npm publishing plugin is not enabled in the release configuration; this package is a transitive release-tool dependency and is excluded from the Home Assistant archive. This accepts the remaining release-tool crash and custom TLS-verification risks only through 2026-11-08; other advisories, dependency paths and runtime findings remain blocking. Replace or remove this entry when a compatible patched npm bundle is available.
